question: Which of the following animals is warm-blooded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Warm-blooded animals can maintain their body temperature.
 
• The surface area of the animal is large and prevents heat loss, and thus it can maintain temperature.
 
• Warm-blooded animals are cats.
 
• It is surface area/volume ratio is high.
 
• Breathing rate and heart rate are high in warm-blooded animals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cold-blooded animals cannot maintain their body temperature.
 
• Body temperature changes according to the environment.
 
• It's surface area/volume ratio is low, and thus they are unable to maintain its body temperature.
 
• Snakes, lizards, frogs, salamanders, and lower invertebrates are examples.
